title: In the Absence of Knowledge
subtitle: Encoding-only cache geometry achieves perfect separation; the confab decision is a coin flip at a balanced logit
abstract: KV-cache geometry separates known from unknown entities at AUROC 0.9995 [0.82, 0.99] (encoding-only: 1.0000) on token-matched prompts. The model generates more confident tokens when confabulating than when answering honestly (logit margin d=0.91). The hedge/confab decision resolves at a single balanced-logit token where sampling determines framing, not truthfulness. LLM-judge reclassification reveals the true confab rate is ~8%, not 73% --- the model is well-calibrated, and regex classifiers masked this.
